definitions.unit: One unique question per experiment-condition; never pool seeds/arms/suites as independent questions
definitions.oracle: Any-agent EM and best-agent F1 are diagnostic upper bounds requiring gold selection, not deployable performance
definitions.aggregation: Deterministic majority of normalized answers, ties follow fixed node order; E3 is receiver 1, not majority
definitions.f1: Continuous official answer F1; no arbitrary F1 correctness threshold; EM analyzed separately
definitions.delta: Final endpoint minus initial endpoint includes revision and selection, not a causal effect of aggregation alone
definitions.mean_candidate_reference: Final F1 minus candidate-mean F1 describes vote selection relative to uniform candidate sampling; not a measured randomized arm
definitions.intervals: Descriptive marginal 95% Wilson intervals for question-level counts and 2000-resample question bootstrap for mean F1 change; not multiplicity-adjusted
unobservable: Whether model internally used delivered evidence
Counterfactual outcome without a particular correct proposal
